subject: storytime
title: Nate the Great words
about: Nate is a boy detective who loves pancakes, and in his first case he hunts for his friend Annie's missing painting of her dog. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the book, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: Borrow the book from the library after the level and read it together, pausing to guess the answer before Nate does.

book.author: Marjorie Weinman Sharmat
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: A pancake-loving detective takes on the case of a missing picture.
